title: Single, dimensionally consistent fail-stack rule outside the algorithms
decisions: K3 (rule of item 1.5 approved as written)
purpose: Implement the approved rule as a pure module. runtime_core wires it into agent_service, rl_algorithms removes the legacy mechanisms inside TD3 and PPO, data_model adds the per-agent fields.

rule.failure: f_i(t) = 1 if the bid of plant i at t was rejected (accepted_quantity == 0) or margin_i < m_min, with margin_i = g_i / (p_acc * q_acc) (TL/TL, unitless).
rule.counter: n_i <- n_i + 1 if f_i(t) = 1, else n_i <- 0.
rule.intervention: If n_i >= L at the decision for t+1: price_i ~ U[max(low, PTF(t) - delta), PTF(t)), clipped to [low, high], then n_i <- 0. delta in TL/MWh.
rule.buffer_action: The applied price, converted with action_space.from_price, is the stored action. The intervened flag is recorded per plant.
rule.ppo: Intervened steps are masked out of the clipped policy loss and kept in the value loss (implemented in rl_algorithms, package ppo).
rule.scope: Learning algorithms only. Baselines (RANDOM, MARGINAL_COST, FIXED_MARKUP) never get interventions.

public_interfaces.description: Validates limit >= 1, delta >= 0, min_margin finite. Raises ValueError otherwise.
Returns None if agent.failstack_enabled is False or the agent's algorithm is a baseline. Reads only attributes, no query. Uses getattr defaults so it works before data_model lands.
One counter per plant in Plant.id order. n_plants >= 1.

public_interfaces.signature: def margin(outcome: OfferOutcome, profit: Decimal) -> Decimal | None
public_interfaces.description: profit / (acceptance_price * accepted_quantity). None if that revenue is 0.

public_interfaces.signature: def is_failure(outcome: OfferOutcome, profit: Decimal, min_margin: Decimal) -> bool
public_interfaces.description: True if rejected or margin < min_margin. The revenue-zero case follows OQ-13 (proposal: failure iff profit < 0).

public_interfaces.signature: def update_counters(state: FailStackState, failures: Sequence[bool]) -> None
public_interfaces.description: In-place update. len(failures) must equal len(state.counters), else ValueError.

public_interfaces.signature: def intervention_price(ptf_prev: Decimal, delta: Decimal, low: Decimal, high: Decimal, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Decimal
public_interfaces.description: Draws from U[a, b) with a = max(low, ptf_prev - delta), b = ptf_prev, clips to [low, high], quantises to Decimal('0.01'). If b <= a it returns min(max(ptf_prev, low), high). Uses only the passed generator (seeded per agent).

public_interfaces.signature: def apply_interventions(state: FailStackState, params: FailStackParams, prices: Sequence[Decimal], ptf_prev: Decimal | None, low: Decimal, high: Decimal, rng: np.random.Generator) -> tuple[list[Decimal], list[bool]]
public_interfaces.description: For each plant with counters[i] >= limit: replace the price with intervention_price and reset counters[i] to 0. Returns (applied_prices, intervened_flags). If ptf_prev is None no intervention happens and counters stay unchanged.

data_model_changes: none in this spec (fields added by data_model)
invariants: Unit invariance: scaling all prices, costs, PTF, delta and bounds by the same factor (TL to kurus) does not change any failure decision, counter value or intervention flag.
An intervention for plant i happens only after L consecutive failures of plant i since its last reset.
Intervened prices satisfy low <= p <= high, and p < PTF(t-1) whenever PTF(t-1) - delta < PTF(t-1) and PTF(t-1) > low.
The module holds no global state, reads no settings and does not import django.
edge_cases: delta = 0: interval empty, returns PTF(t-1) clipped to [low, high].
ptf_prev > high (cannot happen with validated bounds): clipped to high.
accepted_quantity > 0 and acceptance_price == 0: margin undefined, OQ-13.
Length mismatch between prices, counters and failures: ValueError.
test_plan: Counter sequence: F,F,S,F,F,F,F,F,F with L = 6 triggers exactly one intervention at the ninth decision and resets the counter.
Unit invariance property test with 100 random outcomes and scale factor 100.
intervention_price bounds over 10 000 draws with a fixed seed, empty interval, ptf below low.
Determinism: same generator seed gives the same intervention prices.
from_agent returns None for failstack_enabled False and for baseline algorithm types.

research_debug.bug_impact_note: Previous runs mixed three different rules depending on the algorithm. The note is carried by the runtime_core commit that removes the legacy mechanisms.

acceptance_criteria: No import of django or abmem.models at module level in failstack.py (Agent is referenced only as a string type hint)
approval_note: Approved by the user on 2026-10-06. Open questions OQ-1..OQ-19 are resolved in ARCHITECTURE.md section 11. The entries in resolved_open_questions are binding and override any wording below that says "proposal", "per OQ-x" or "if approved".

resolved_open_questions.OQ-13: If accepted revenue p_acc * q_acc == 0 for an accepted offer, the offer is a failure only if profit < 0.
